posts.headline: Petraeus Baghdad visit floated as possible US envoy appointment
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch flags retired General David Petraeus's notable Baghdad visit and the rumours around a possible US envoy appointment, slotting alongside the live US pressure on the al-Zaidi cabinet's militia and security-cabinet files.

posts.headline: Iranian regime media framing of the Surdash strikes flagged as a tell on official posture
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch notes that Iran's Fars News framing of the overnight Surdash drone strikes on Iranian Kurdish opposition groups reveals how Tehran-aligned media is publicly positioning on cross-border targeting inside the Sulaimani area.

posts.headline: KIU's Bahaddin meets KRG PM Masrour Barzani after PUK Talabani session, broadening the deadlock-breaking initiative
posts.summary: After Monday's Sulaimani meeting with PUK's Bafel Talabani, Kurdistan Islamic Union leader Salahaddin Bahaddin met KRG PM Masrour Barzani to push his national initiative on the 18-month KRG cabinet deadlock, taking the proposal across the two main party leaderships in 48 hours.

posts.headline: Four overnight drone strikes hit Komala Toilers Surdash camp near Sulaimani
posts.summary: Four drone strikes targeted the Iranian Kurdish opposition group Komala Toilers at its Surdash camp near Sulaimani overnight, the second multi-strike incident on the same camp in five weeks after the April 14 attack that killed Ghazal Molan and the early-May follow-on.

posts.headline: Sadiqoun political bureau member ties any ministry handover to AAH weapons handover first
posts.summary: An AAH-aligned Sadiqoun political bureau member said the agreement on Asaib taking a ministry rests on the weapons handover coming first, anchoring the bloc's cabinet entry to the arms-monopoly file. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Saad al-Saadi: AAH weapons handover after Eid, arms-monopoly process underway
posts.summary: Sadiqoun political bureau member Saad al-Saadi declared the brothers of Zainab's weapons will be handed over after Eid Al-Adha and that the broader confinement of arms to the state is in motion, framing the post-Eid window as the test of the al-Zaidi cabinet's militia file. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: WSJ via mediators says US-Iran talks not making notable progress
posts.summary: AMrym flags Wall Street Journal reporting that the mediators in the parallel US-Iran channel say the talks are not making notable progress, against the Trump pause on the May 19 strike. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: US officials cited on a possible limited Iran strike as early as next week
posts.summary: US media via US officials, relayed by AMrym, says a limited strike on Iran may come as early as next week, putting a short tail on Trump's just-announced pause and lining up against the WSJ mediator readout. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iraqi Army chief of staff meets head of CTS in a preliminary session
posts.summary: AMrym flags a preliminary meeting between the Iraqi Army chief of staff and the head of the Counter-Terrorism Service that he frames as part of the lead-in to a coming reshuffle at the top of the security stack, with implications for the security-cabinet completion after Eid. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: PM al-Zaidi coordinates with senior Gulf leaders on the UAE Barakah investigation and the formation of a joint committee
posts.summary: PM Ali al-Zaidi is coordinating with senior Gulf leaders on the investigation into the latest attack on the UAE and on standing up a joint committee on the airspace-launch incidents, ahead of the formal Iraqi-territory attribution from Abu Dhabi later in the day. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: PM al-Zaidi directs market monitoring and price stability on essential goods through independent oversight
posts.summary: PM al-Zaidi instructed the relevant ministries to monitor markets and stabilise prices on essential goods through independent follow-up, his first cabinet-level move on the cost-of-living file ahead of Eid Al-Adha. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Integrity Commission widens the al-Hasnawi corruption file with a documented question on his son
posts.summary: AMrym flags the Integrity Commission widening the corruption file on former Health Minister Saleh al-Hasnawi with a documented question targeting his son, signalling the file is hardening rather than quieting under the new cabinet. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Direct on-camera clash between the Babil governor and a Hashd al-Shaabi unit
posts.summary: Video relayed by AMrym shows a direct confrontation between the Babil governor and a PMF force, with the governor on camera challenging the unit's pointing of launchers in his direction, an unusually public local-state versus PMF stand-off in the post-formation window. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iraqi Observatory: PMF elements running repeat raids on a private compound
posts.summary: The Iraqi Observatory for Human Rights, via AMrym, reports that PMF elements are conducting repeated raids on a specific private compound, adding to the same week's stack of PMF-versus-civilian and PMF-versus-local-state friction points. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: VP JD Vance: Iran has two options, an agreement or war resuming
posts.summary: AMrym relays VP Vance's Tuesday White House line that Iran has two options, either an agreement or the resumption of the war, which is the cleanest binary framing from the administration since the pause on the May 19 strike. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: US Embassy Baghdad employee Qind Muhammad Faraj al-Janabi arrested on bribery and corruption charges
posts.summary: AMrym reports the arrest of a Baghdad-based US Embassy employee, named Qind Muhammad Faraj al-Janabi, on bribery and corruption charges, a sensitive case on the bilateral interface as US engagement on the security file intensifies. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Gold negatively correlated to oil during the Iran war, a regime-shift call for energy investors
posts.summary: Bacharelhalabi boosts a BurggrabenH thread arguing that since the start of the war gold has been negatively correlated to oil, an unusual macro pattern that he flags as relevant for energy investors sizing the Brent and risk-asset paths.

posts.headline: Saudi Mawani launches the Red Sea Express container service, signal on Gulf logistics rewiring
posts.summary: Bacharelhalabi signal-boosts a staunovo line that Saudi Ports Authority Mawani has launched the Red Sea Express shipping service, a discrete data point on the post-Hormuz Gulf logistics rewiring and the Kingdom's positioning on Red Sea throughput.

posts.headline: Knights flags Abu Ali al-Basri's friend network as a tell on the next security-cabinet round
posts.summary: Knights points to who else National Security Service chief Abu Ali al-Basri is friends with as relevant for sizing the next round of security-cabinet appointments, signalling the kind of background-screen work that should be running on the security portfolios before the post-Eid completion of the Zaidi line-up.

posts.headline: Knights: CTS bench still wants the service to return to its peak posture
posts.summary: Quote-tweeting the broader Iraqi security-stack conversation, Knights says a lot of Counter-Terrorism Service personnel still want the service to return to its prior peak posture, an important read on the institutional appetite as the al-Zaidi cabinet works the security file.

posts.headline: Knights welcomes the new push to get Western tech companies into Iraq's telecoms sector
posts.summary: Knights flags the new push to bring credible Western tech companies into Iraq's telecoms sector under the al-Zaidi cabinet, an early signal on the sector-opening posture and on the kind of US-aligned economic deliverables that could land alongside the security-file pressure.
